distribution.narrative: Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides secondary checklist evidence supporting occurrence in Hong Kong. No mainland-China, Taiwan, or Macao occurrence is inferred from this source.

taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ips amitinus (Eichhoff, 1872).

taxonomic_history.name: Tomicus amitinus montanus
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 80.

taxonomic_history.name: Ips montanus
taxonomic_history.note: Listed under Ips amitinus by Douglas et al. (2019), explicitly distinguished from Ips montanus (Eichhoff, 1881). The original 1913 rank and combination require further primary-source review.

taxonomic_history.name: Ips amitinus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Canonical identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Ips amitinus (Eichhoff, 1872), VSN_3393. Taxonomic caution: Ips montanus Fuchs, 1913 has been listed as a synonym of Ips amitinus. It should not be confused with Ips montanus (Eichhoff, 1881), a distinct North American species (Douglas et al., 2019).
